scope: Publication evidence only; numeric experiments are unchanged.
finding: The shared soil_water_solve_result_t field unrounded_mass_balance_residual currently has solver-dependent dimensional semantics.

reference_route.definition: sum of the final HeadCalc residual vector
reference_route.residual_equation: (theta - theta_previous) * dz / dt plus source/sink and boundary flux-rate terms
reference_route.physical_unit: cm/day for the current SWAP native unit system
reference_route.consequence: Reference compartment_balance_tolerance and total_balance_tolerance used by HeadCalc are also flux-rate residual criteria in cm/day, not integrated water-depth criteria in cm.

rossfast_route.consequence: ROSSFAST_D3R_HARD_MASS_TOL_CM=1e-12 is an integrated water-depth mass bound.

affected_publication_labels: P2_REFERENCE_UNCERTAINTY_PILOT_RESULT.json labels Reference coarse/half mass residuals as cm; these numeric Reference values should be read as cm/day.

P2_REFERENCE_CALIBRATION_MATRIX_PREREGISTRATION.json and P2E03_BLOCKED_REFERENCE_CALIBRATION_CHECKPOINT.json use _cm labels for Reference HeadCalc compartment/total convergence tolerances and final residuals; the numeric settings/results were executed exactly as recorded but their correct unit is cm/day.

P2E04_REFERENCE_BALANCE_ADJUDICATION_PREREGISTRATION.json, P2E04_STAGE_A_FAILURE_CENSUS_RESULT.json and P2E04_STAGE_BC_RESULT.json similarly use _cm labels for Reference internal convergence tolerances/residual-vector sums; interpret those labels as cm/day.

scientific_impact.note: The Reference transaction layer separately constructs integrated storage and flux accounting using step duration; this erratum concerns the solver diagnostic/convergence residual field and publication gates built directly on that field, not a demonstrated defect in accepted transaction mass conservation.

provenance_rule: Do not rewrite the preregistered numeric inputs or failed experiment history. Preserve the original files and attach this erratum as the authoritative unit interpretation correction.
next_permitted_action: Open a separate solver-contract workunit to decide whether soil_water_solve_result_t must expose distinct rate-residual and integrated-mass-residual quantities, or normalize the existing field to one documented physical dimension. Requalify any publication gate that compared the Reference field directly with the RossFast integrated hard mass bound.
